description: A venue operations director must approve the binding production plan for a live filmmaker Q&A at an outdoor festival courtyard, including the microphone system, recording format, public release date, and required follow-up production commitments.

shared_context.S1: The festival's outdoor courtyard will host a live filmmaker Q&A after the evening screening.
shared_context.S2: The Q&A is planned for four speakers and will be recorded for the festival's podcast feed.
shared_context.S3: Mara must approve the final production and release plan before the courtyard is opened to guests.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard production meeting includes an oral status round in which the sound and rights leads report on their agenda areas before Mara signs off; agenda decisions and follow-up tasks are entered in the meeting minutes.
shared_context.S5: The approval agenda covers the microphone setup, recording format, podcast release date, and recording the two follow-up status-report commitments; those commitments may be completed after the meeting.

PF1.text: Jonah completed an RF survey of the courtyard after the soundcheck and found that wireless microphones are unreliable there because of interference from the neighboring broadcast compound; the Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones, and the survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed with the filmmaker's representative that the appearance release permits an audio-only recording, prohibits public video release, and allows the podcast episode to be released only on September 15, 2026; the confirmation arrived after the rights packet was circulated and has not yet been entered in the event file.

acceptance_conditions: The Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones.
Wireless microphones must not be permitted.
The public release date must be exactly September 15, 2026.
A sound-system documentation commitment targeting Jonah and referring to the RF survey report and production folder must be logged.
A rights-documentation commitment targeting Elena and referring to the appearance release or updated rights confirmation must be logged.
Both private findings must be formally revealed by their owners and cited by Mara in the final justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['wireless_microphones_permitted'] == False and ('four wired microphones' in decisions['microphone_setup'] or 'Four wired microphones' in decisions['microphone_setup'] or 'exactly four wired microphones' in decisions['microphone_setup'] or 'Exactly four wired microphones' in decisions['microphone_setup'])
content_checks.C3: ('audio-only' in decisions['recording_format'] or 'Audio-only' in decisions['recording_format'] or 'audio only' in decisions['recording_format'] or 'Audio only' in decisions['recording_format'])
content_checks.C4: decisions['public_release_date'] == 'September 15, 2026' or decisions['public_release_date'] == '2026-09-15' or decisions['public_release_date'] == '2026/09/15' or 'September 15, 2026' in decisions['public_release_date']
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Jonah' and ('RF survey' in c['detail'] or 'rf survey' in c['detail']) and ('production folder' in c['detail'] or 'Production folder' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Elena' and c['type'] in ['document_filing', 'status_report_submission', 'submission_required', 'submission', 'file_update_required', 'file_update', 'document_upload'] and ('appearance release' in c['detail'] or 'Appearance release' in c['detail'] or 'rights confirmation' in c['detail'] or 'updated rights' in c['detail'] or 'filmmaker representative' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1:Jonah' in revealed and 'PF2:Elena' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The RF survey changes the microphone_setup decision to exactly four wired microphones while wireless_microphones_permitted becomes False, and it changes the commitments by requiring Jonah's RF survey report to be uploaded to the production folder.

The appearance release changes recording_format to audio-only, fixes public_release_date at September 15, 2026, requires Elena's appearance-release confirmation to be entered in the event file, and requires PF2 to be formally revealed and cited.
